description:
Title: Car Service

The police has a new app to remind you of your car service.
The process is started after a successful service.
When a service is necessary, the system checks if your car is still registered.
If it is registered, you are notified.
If you do not go to the service, you are fined after 30 days.
At the car service facility the mechanic enters the problems of your car for reference.
While you wait (can take several days), you get status updates via email.
You can pay through the app, when the repair is done.
The mechanic enters that the repair was successful and you got your "Pickerl".
The mechanic enters the time for you next service.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_CarService" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/car-service">

  <bpmn:message id="Message_ServiceDone" name="Successful service with next service date"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ServiceReminder" name="Service reminder"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_CarDelivered" name="Car delivered for service"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_CarReceived" name="Car received at facility"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_StatusUpdate" name="Repair status update"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Payment" name="Payment via app"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_CarService">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_PoliceApp" name="Police Service Reminder App" processRef="Process_PoliceApp"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Owner" name="Car Owner"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Facility" name="Car Service Facility" processRef="Process_Facility"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Reminder" name="Service reminder" sourceRef="Task_NotifyOwner" targetRef="Participant_Owner" messageRef="Message_ServiceReminder"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CarDelivered" name="Car delivered" sourceRef="Participant_Owner" targetRef="Start_CarDelivered" messageRef="Message_CarDelivered"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CarReceived" name="Car received" sourceRef="Task_ConfirmReceipt" targetRef="Catch_CarBroughtToService" messageRef="Message_CarReceived"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_StatusUpdate" name="Status update" sourceRef="Task_SendStatus" targetRef="Participant_Owner" messageRef="Message_StatusUpdate"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Payment" name="Payment" sourceRef="Participant_Owner" targetRef="Catch_Payment" messageRef="Message_Payment"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ServiceDone" name="Successful service" sourceRef="Task_SendNextService" targetRef="Start_ServiceDone" messageRef="Message_ServiceDone"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_PoliceApp" name="Police Service Reminder" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_ServiceDone" name="Successful service recorded">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_ServiceDone" messageRef="Message_ServiceDone"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_CheckRegistration" name="Check car registration"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Registered" name="Car still registered?" default="Flow_NotRegistered"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_NotifyOwner" name="Notify owner of service due"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_ServiceEvent" name="Owner goes to service?"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_CarBroughtToService" name="Car brought to service">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_CarBrought" messageRef="Message_CarReceived"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Timer_30Days" name="30 days passed">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TED_30Days">
        <bpmn:timeDuration xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">P30D</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_IssueFine" name="Issue fine"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Fined" name="Owner fined"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Serviced" name="Service visit recorded"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_NotRegistered" name="No reminder sent"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckRegistration" sourceRef="Start_ServiceDone" targetRef="Task_CheckRegistration"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RegistrationCheck" sourceRef="Task_CheckRegistration" targetRef="Gateway_Registered"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Registered" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Registered" targetRef="Task_NotifyOwner">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${registered == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotRegistered" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Registered" targetRef="End_NotRegistered"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Notified" sourceRef="Task_NotifyOwner" targetRef="Gateway_ServiceEvent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WaitVisit" sourceRef="Gateway_ServiceEvent" targetRef="Catch_CarBroughtToService"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WaitTimer" sourceRef="Gateway_ServiceEvent" targetRef="Timer_30Days"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_VisitRecorded" sourceRef="Catch_CarBroughtToService" targetRef="End_Serviced"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Overdue" sourceRef="Timer_30Days" targetRef="Task_IssueFine"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Fined" sourceRef="Task_IssueFine" targetRef="End_Fined"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Facility" name="Car Service Facility" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_CarDelivered" name="Car delivered for service">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_CarDelivered" messageRef="Message_CarDelivered"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ConfirmReceipt" name="Confirm car receipt to app"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_RecordProblems" name="Mechanic enters car problems for reference"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Repair" name="Repair car"/>
    <bpmn:boundaryEvent id="Boundary_StatusInterval" name="Status update interval" attachedToRef="Task_Repair" cancelActivity="false">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TED_StatusInterval">
        <bpmn:timeCycle xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">R/P1D</bpmn:timeCycle>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:boundaryEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendStatus" name="Send status update email"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_StatusSent" name="Status update sent"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_RecordRepair" name="Mechanic enters successful repair and issues Pickerl"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_Payment" name="Payment received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Payment" messageRef="Message_Payment"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterNextService" name="Mechanic enters next service time"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendNextService" name="Send successful service and next service date to app"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ServiceCompleted" name="Service completed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Received" sourceRef="Start_CarDelivered" targetRef="Task_ConfirmReceipt"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ConfirmedProblems" sourceRef="Task_ConfirmReceipt" targetRef="Task_RecordProblems"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartRepair" sourceRef="Task_RecordProblems" targetRef="Task_Repair"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StatusTimer" sourceRef="Boundary_StatusInterval" targetRef="Task_SendStatus"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StatusSent" sourceRef="Task_SendStatus" targetRef="End_StatusSent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RepairDone" sourceRef="Task_Repair" targetRef="Task_RecordRepair"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AwaitPayment" sourceRef="Task_RecordRepair" targetRef="Catch_Payment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PaidNextService" sourceRef="Catch_Payment" targetRef="Task_EnterNextService"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendNext" sourceRef="Task_EnterNextService" targetRef="Task_SendNextService"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Completed" sourceRef="Task_SendNextService" targetRef="End_ServiceCompleted"/>
  </bpmn:process>

</bpmn:definitions>
